title: Perfect constant levels have bounded finite lisse cohomology
statement: For a scheme Y, an adic coefficient datum d on A, an algebraic tower T and n, if T.level n is perfect [def-pc-perfect-ring-complex], the explicit finitePerfectAdicEtaleConstant Y T n [def-weil-pbc-finite-perfect-adic-constant-normalization] has cohomology zero outside a finite integer interval and finite locally constant cohomology in every degree [def-constructible-finite-locally-constant]. This statement has no actual completed-coefficient object or marking.

source.place: Tag 09C6, finite quotient levels and the normalized algebraic diagram; Tags 06YY and 09BV.

proof.text: Choose the algebraic cohomological bounds from IsPerfect.exists_homologyConcentratedIn. Exactness of universe lift, ring-equivalence scalar restriction and constants preserves the two vanishing inequalities.

The quotient ring is finite, hence Noetherian. IsPerfect.finite_homology makes each algebraic cohomology module finite; its lifted module has finite carrier and is finitely generated over the lifted quotient ring. The constant sheaf of this module is finite locally constant.
Apply mapDerivedCategoryHomologyFunctorIso for the universe lift and for constants. Transport finite local constancy through the resulting isomorphism with cohomology of the constant complex.

lean.statement:
theorem finitePerfectAdicEtaleConstant_cohomology (Y : Scheme.{t})
    {A : Type t} [CommRing A] {d : AdicCoefficientDatum A}
    (T : FinitePerfectAdicAlgebraTower d) (n : ℕ)
    (hp : DerivedCategory.IsPerfect (T.level n)) :
    (∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ i : ℤ, i < a ∨ b < i → IsZero
      ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ i).obj (finitePerfectAdicEtaleConstant Y T n))) ∧
    (∀ i : ℤ, IsFiniteLocallyConstantSheaf
      ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ i).obj (finitePerfectAdicEtaleConstant Y T n)))
